graph_history_op_shape.name: graph_history_op_shape
graph_history_op_shape.value:
("graph_history"."op" = 'create' AND "graph_history"."before" IS NULL AND "graph_history"."after" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("graph_history"."op" = 'delete' AND "graph_history"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "graph_history"."after" IS NULL)
        OR ("graph_history"."op" IN ('update', 'retract') AND "graph_history"."before" IS NOT NULL AND "graph_history"."after" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_playbook_run_step_fan_uq.name: jobs_playbook_run_step_fan_uq
jobs_playbook_run_step_fan_uq.where: "jobs"."playbook_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."retry_of_job_id" IS NULL

provider_call_outcomes_body_shape_ck.name: provider_call_outcomes_body_shape_ck
provider_call_outcomes_body_shape_ck.value:
("provider_call_outcomes"."body_state" <> 'none' OR ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_sha256" IS NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."body_bytes" IS NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."blob_key" IS NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."body_reason" IS NULL))
        AND ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_state" NOT IN ('stored', 'hashed', 'partial') OR ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."body_bytes" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_state" <> 'stored' OR ("provider_call_outcomes"."blob_key" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."body_reason" IS NULL))
        AND ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_state" <> 'hashed' OR ("provider_call_outcomes"."blob_key" IS NULL AND "provider_call_outcomes"."body_reason" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("provider_call_outcomes"."body_state" <> 'partial' OR "provider_call_outcomes"."body_reason" IS NOT NULL)

provider_calls_request_body_hash_ck.name: provider_calls_request_body_hash_ck
provider_calls_request_body_hash_ck.value: ("provider_calls"."request_body_state" = 'hashed') = ("provider_calls"."request_body_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_calls"."request_body_bytes" IS NOT NULL)
